reviews.title: Decent game, declining service
reviews.text:
In short: new servers are laggy and don’t have infrastructure to ensure events work properly. Seems like devs are getting as much $$ as they can before shifting to newer titles. If the devs aren’t willing to spend $$ on the game, it is hard to recommend others to spend their time/$$.

Longer review:
4 new global servers released on 8/21/26. 8/22 is the first, weekly event featuring a ‘sect clash’ between multiple servers

This event is a limited time, exciting, and competitive event with a 10 minute window. 10 minutes! If you are 60s late, you missed 10% of the event

The server performance and lag was horrible for everyone. Commands would take 3-5s for a response and my screen would update every 1-3s. This is consistent event-wide, with many people commenting in the chat.

This game is decent, but unfortunately this shows a decline in service for this game. Releasing new servers despite no infrastructure to ensure critical events can function properly.

If you enjoy cultivation games and want a short-term game, try it. If you’re looking for a mid/long-term game or something to spend money on, look elsewhere. The company is clearly shifting resources to newer titles, this is a horrible sign for any future events in this server and newer servers

reviews.title: Extreme Pay 2 Win
reviews.text: So, besides the great art style and amazing storytelling, this game is meant for the huge whales. Like leviathans. Or the sky whales called Dapeng in this game (they are beyond massive) 🐋. The amount of money these ppl throw at this game is insane. So don’t expect to get anywhere fast, or even think of winning in PvP. The grind is long and slow at times if you haven’t spent any money. They finally added the ability to get backgrounds, but you must spend lots to get them. As far as combat, everyone is a circular profile pic with fancy effects. And that’s it. The cool looking gear is really just displayed on your profile when people look you up. I have enjoyed the story, but I recommend avoiding this game like the plague until the cost of everything comes down significantly.

The game play is great but there aren’t a lot of weekly and normal events, if you’re new the abilities can be very confusing so it’d be good to choose your cultivation path carefully as you can only change at like voidbreak.
